independentAdversarial.meaning: 5 failures prove4 distinct metadata defects; passing primitive-control proves aggregate0, not native identity.

findings.issue: Alive records with non-null terminalStep pass due OR branch; later death overwrites/normalizes the malformed source.
findings.minimumCorrection: Require phase===alive ? terminalStep===null : finite terminalStep>=bornStep, and validate proposed full schema before publishing.
findings.authorityScope: Metadata integrity only, not native combat authority.

findings.issue: Future namespace added in the last CAS raw getter is not re-censused; born writes v1 alongside now-present unknownv2 instead of HOLD.
findings.minimumCorrection: Bounded coherent census/raw recapture after getters and immediately before publication/readback; preserve unknown namespaces without v1 writes.
findings.authorityScope: Synthetic side-effecting injected port; not an observed Bedrock native failure.

findings.issue: Per-instance lock permits nested second factory to acknowledge b1, then outer setter replaces it with a1; both successful but one record lost.
findings.minimumCorrection: Share world/key operation exclusion or enforce one private instance with an explicit proven no-second-writer boundary. Detect/reject nested writes before either acknowledged observation can be lost.
findings.authorityScope: Reentrant injected port proof; current production callsite disabled and real engine callback behavior not assumed.

findings.issue: candidate.id is captured once, then lookup re-reads p.id after native load. Mutation of plain DTO can append duplicate captured ID and persist a self-invalid journal while returning true.
findings.minimumCorrection: Snapshot all primitive fields once, use candidate.id consistently and validate complete output schema/uniqueness before write; do not treat supplied primitives as fresh native proof.
findings.authorityScope: Mutable synthetic primitive DTO/native-port callback; not fabricated native combat acceptance.

positiveScope: No native actor/world handles escape; no entity spawn/remove/terrain/timer/listener/query code in proposed journal.

integrationBlockers: Correct metadata findings before optional hooks.

notFindings: Accepting fabricated primitive observations is not by itself a native-authority vulnerability: this factory explicitly trusts its caller, is unconfigured in main and never applies aggregate effects. The private adapter must establish provenance later.
Loaded absence/top-up is current existing owner policy demonstrated by repro, not a new bug to patch with a casualty debit.
No source edits, native combat, physical breach, finite-army depletion, physical arrival/withdrawal or resource outcomes reviewed as complete.
